data.question: What direct publication attribution can be resolved for Katherine Hsiao at the maximum configured recursion depth?
data.method: Cross-check WEF publication identity/date against paper-repository author metadata and current WEF council publication surfaces.
data.scope: Direct Hsiao authorship and remaining council-output attribution gaps.
findings: WEF publishes Data Equity:Foundational Concepts for Generative AI as a briefing paper dated 17 October 2023.
arXiv record 2311.10741 for the same title lists Katherine Hsiao among the authors.
This establishes a direct Hsiao-to-2023-WEF-output relationship that was not available from the earlier 2021 Pathways HTML review.

WEF's 2024 Advancing Data Equity page states that the paper was produced by members of the Global Future Council on Data Equity, but this HTML page does not individually name Hsiao; contributor-level attribution remains artifact-dependent.
conclusions: Hsiao's direct contribution to a WEF data-governance output is now verified for the 2023 Data Equity briefing paper.
The separate 2021 Pathways authorship question remains unresolved rather than inferred from council membership.
limitations: The WEF-hosted PDFs still time out in this research environment; the new scraper must recover/hash them elsewhere for first-party contributor-page preservation.
